description: Render a typographic card — headline, versus (two columns), list, stat (one big number) or quote — as a PNG or JPEG at 1920x1080 or 2560x1440. Deterministic layout, no AI model: the text you send is exactly what appears, which no image generator can promise. Built for video title cards and slides, thumbnails, quote cards and social posts. Lists and comparisons REVEAL one beat at a time (revealed:N / show_right:false) — render N states and cut between them, and the text never shifts. Optional theme (hex colours). Text coverage: Latin, Greek and Cyrillic (DejaVu Sans) with Noto Sans fallback for Arabic, Indic, Thai, Chinese, Japanese and Korean; emoji render as single-colour silhouettes in the text colour, not in full colour. Returns { url, width, height, format, mime, expires_in_seconds } — the url is a signed download valid 2 h; fetch it, the image is not inlined. Hard caps: 3 lines x 40 chars, 6 items x 40 chars — a spec over a cap is refused BEFORE payment. 5 sats per card. Pay per request with Bitcoin Lightning — no API key or signup needed. Requires create_payment with toolName='render_card'.

accent_line.description: headline: index of the line drawn in the accent colour

items.description: list: 1-6 items, each up to 40 chars; the last revealed item is drawn in the accent colour

label.description: stat: caption under the number (up to 60 chars)

left_label.description: versus: small label over the left value (up to 28 chars)

lines.description: headline: 1-3 lines, each up to 40 characters

revealed.description: list: how many items are shown (default all) — render 1..N for a beat-by-beat reveal

right.description: versus: right value, drawn in the accent colour

right_label.description: versus: small label over the right value

show_right.description: versus: false renders the left column only (first beat of a two-state reveal)

sub.description: stat: small line above the number, e.g. a year

text.description: quote: the quoted words (up to 30 chars)

theme.description: Optional hex colours: background, foreground, accent, muted (default: near-black ground, Bitcoin-orange accent)

title.description: list: small caps title (up to 40 chars)

value.description: stat: the big number (up to 12 chars), e.g. '34 Md $'

name: render_card
